The Bison, led by second-year head coach [[Kenny Blakeney]], played their home games at [[Burr Gymnasium]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as members of the [[Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference]] (MEAC). With the creation of divisions to cut down on travel due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they will play in the Northern Division.{{Cite news|url=https://meacsports.com/news/2020/12/14/meac-announces-revised-conference-schedules-for-mens-womens-basketball.aspx|title=MEAC Announces Revised Conference Schedules for Men's, Women's Basketball|work=Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference|date=December 14, 2020|access-date=January 26, 2021|language=en}} They finished the season 1–4, 0–0 in MEAC play, before suspending their season on February 9, 2021, due to an abundance of positive cases amongst their players amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite news |last=Bryant |first=Derek W. |date=February 9, 2021 |title=Men's Basketball Cancels Remainder of 2020-21 Season |url=https://hubison.com/news/2021/2/9/mens-basketball-cancels-remainder-of-2020-21-season.aspx |access-date=February 9, 2021 |work=Howard University Athletics |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Howard Bison men's basketball team|Bison]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 4–29, 1–15 in MEAC play, to finish in last place. They defeated [[2019–20 South Carolina State Bulldogs basketball team|South Carolina State]] in the first round of the [[2020 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]],{{Cite news|url=https://meacsports.com/news/2020/3/10/mens-basketball-williams-leads-howard-to-first-round-upset-overs-c-state.aspx|title=Williams Leads Howard to First-Round Upset Over S.C. State|work=Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference|date=March 10, 2020|access-date=January 26, 2021|language=en}} before losing to [[2019–20 North Carolina A&T Aggies men's basketball team|North Carolina
